adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed rwk-complete-test-0001: worker-2 recovered prose-supported activity/toxicity rows, worker-4 reconciled linked APD6/DBAASP/CAMP records while preserving overreaching database claims as conflicts, and worker-6 accepted the paper with explicit cautions rather than clean acceptance.

materials_exhausted.note: All local packet/source/database surfaces relevant to the ticket were opened; supplementary PDF adds purity/mass support but no activity table.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF prose supports MIC 50 ug/mL, MFC 200 ug/mL, C. albicans MTT viability values, HEK293/HEK293T viability >95% up to 100 ug/mL, and zebrafish infection-model mortality reduction. No unsupported table rows were invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: DBAASP MIC/MFC rows and CAMP antifungal entry are source-supported; APD6 AP03250 and DBAASP HEK293 exact-killing rows retain source_conflict where database text is broader or more exact than the primary paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The original open ticket is closed because all targeted worker-2/4/6 omissions have source-reviewed responses; remaining limitations are cautions with concrete record identifiers and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism_review: Mechanism claims are bounded to FE-SEM morphology, PI uptake membrane permeability, and ROS fluorescence; speculative pore/channel/nuclear/apoptosis extensions are not promoted to direct mechanisms.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Results report 9.25% C. albicans viability at 100 ug/mL, while Discussion reports 5%; both are preserved.
APD6 AP03250 comment includes anti-sepsis, E. coli, RAW 264.7, hemolysis, and wax-moth statements not supported by this 2020 local source.
DBAASP encodes 5% killing at 100 ug/mL; primary paper supports >95% viability but not an exact 5.00% killing table.
The recovered supplementary PDF contains peptide purity/molecular-weight figure text and does not add activity/toxicity rows.
